definitions.gloss: to pass by, to go past
definitions.explanation: To move past a place or point without stopping.

examples.english: To wait for the car to pass by.

examples.japanese: ⟦{目的地|もくてきち}→目的地：09996_mokutekichi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{通|とお}り{過|す}ぎた⟦こと→こと：01164_koto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{気|き}づいた→気付く：01933_kizuku⟧。
examples.english: I realized I had gone past my destination.

examples.japanese: ⟦{出口|でぐち}→出口：02508_deguchi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{通|とお}り{過|す}ぎてしまった⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧、⟦{戻|もど}らなければならなかった→戻る：01117_modoru⟧。
examples.english: I accidentally went past the exit, so I had to go back.

examples.japanese: ⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{通|とお}り{過|す}ぎた⟦のに→のに：10529_noni⟧、⟦{気|き}づかなくて→気付く：01933_kizuku⟧⟦{声|こえ}→声：02207_koe⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かけられなかった→かける：00854_kakeru⟧。
examples.english: My friend passed right in front of me, but I didn't notice and couldn't call out to them.

notes:
{通|とお}り{過|す}ぎる is a compound ichidan verb combining ⟦{通|とお}る→通る：01243_tooru⟧ (to pass through) + ⟦{過|す}ぎる→過ぎる：01219_sugiru⟧ (to exceed/pass).

TRANSITIVITY:
Intransitive verb (⟦{自動詞|じどうし}→自動詞：10977_jidoushi⟧). Takes を particle for the place passed.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦{駅|えき}→駅：02180_eki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{通|とお}り{過|す}ぎる: to go past the station
- ⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{通|とお}り{過|す}ぎる: to pass before one's eyes
- ⟦{車|くるま}→車：00516_kuruma⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{通|とお}り{過|す}ぎる: a car passes by

USAGE NOTE:
Often used with ⟦〜てしまう→〜てしまう：03102_teshimau⟧ to express accidentally going past something: ⟦{駅|えき}→駅：02180_eki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{通|とお}り{過|す}ぎてしまった (I accidentally missed/passed the station).

RELATED VERBS:
- ⟦{通|とお}る→通る：01243_tooru⟧: to pass through, go along
- ⟦{過|す}ぎる→過ぎる：01219_sugiru⟧: to pass (time), to exceed
